(John 3:14-16 KJV)

Jesus was again predicting His crucifixion (lifted up), but His followers did not seem to understand that He would be hung on a cross and crucified. Most people believe that everlasting life means living forever, and although all people will live forever in one of two places, everlasting or eternal life is defined by Jesus (John 17:3) as being able to know intimately God and Jesus. Having a close relationship with God and Jesus is what Salvation is all about, not just going to Heaven when we die.

Most churches only teach that you need to be saved to keep from going to hell, but that was not the Good News of the Gospel. It is wonderful that we aren’t going to go to hell, but we were saved so that we could have a close relationship with God and Jesus in this life. It was all about bringing us back into a relationship with the Father, that caused Jesus to die for us, and sin was in the way, so it had to be done away with. To assure that we have eternal salvation, we must obey the commands of Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). At the same time Jesus not only took our sins, but He gave us, through the Grace of God, the ability to get wealth, healing and deliverance from the devil. Thank you Jesus!
